bindings.ACCOUNT_DB: D1 binding, configure separately for preview and production

notes: Documentation only. Do not upload this file as a Cloudflare configuration.
TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY is a cryptographically random 32-byte base64url-encoded key.
SQUARE_ENVIRONMENT accepts sandbox or production. Pin and verify the API version before activation.
No credentials or real resource identifiers belong in this example.
EMAIL_FROM must be a bare address on the verified sending domain for the selected provider.
Resend is selected for the free transactional tier; keep RESEND_API_KEY on the server and prefer sending-only access scoped to the sending domain.
Leave click/open tracking disabled for sign-in mail. Account links contain a short-lived fragment challenge.
Cloudflare compatibility remains available explicitly, or when EMAIL_PROVIDER is unset.

alternative_cloudflare_email.note: Sending to arbitrary customers requires the Workers Paid plan; verified destination-only forwarding is not customer signup email.
